purpose: A phase-aware atlas of unusually informative Hugging Face dataset artifacts. It preserves why each artifact matters, where its authority ends, and the smallest honest KINGDOM integration route.

license.scope: The dataset repository declares ODC-By. Source recipes and downstream checkpoints still need their own provenance retained.

viewer.note: The payload is 6,192 OLMo-oriented NumPy token shards, not a Dataset Viewer table.

entries.scale: 25 recipes, 14 model sizes from 4M to 1B parameters, three seeds, more than 30,000 checkpoints, and about 19.27 TB of token shards.
entries.treasure: It exposes the pilot experiments normally discarded before a final pretraining corpus is chosen, allowing recipe rankings to be studied across scale instead of guessed from one large run.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A recipe -> scale -> seed -> checkpoint -> evaluation ledger built from pinned cards and evaluation metadata, without mirroring token shards.
does_not: Download the 19 TB payload
Claim that <=1B English-model rankings transfer universally
Treat a recipe rank as a moral or policy score

known_drift: No Viewer schema exists; an OLMo-specific token adapter would be required for body reads.

license.scope: No dataset-level licence was declared in Hub metadata at observation time. Keep rows remote-reference only until clarified.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes four Parquet-backed configs and overlap witnesses for 5,326 rejected rows.

entries.scale: 5,326 pages rejected from FineMath or InfiMM-WebMath after 13-gram checks against GSM8K, MATH, MMLU, and ARC.
entries.treasure: It preserves negative evidence: the removed page, benchmark overlap, and diff. Most releases keep only the sanitized corpus and erase why a row was excluded.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A remote-reference exclusion-witness schema and synthetic local regression fixtures; no copied web or benchmark text.
does_not: Redistribute rows without licence clarification
Equate an n-gram overlap with proven contamination
Expose held-out benchmark text to a judged agent

license.scope: The dataset repository declares MIT. Embedded benchmark tasks, patches, logs, and tool output remain untrusted evidence with their own provenance.

viewer.note: The verified split has 1,000 curated trajectories; the full split has 3,316. The repository also contains untrusted compressed trace artifacts.

entries.scale: 4,316 manifest rows across two views: full contains 3,316 trajectories and verified is a curated 1,000-row subset, not 1,000 additional unique trajectories.
entries.treasure: It localizes incorrect and merely unuseful steps inside explicit stages, which is far more diagnostic than a final solved/failed bit.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A verified-split trajectory -> stage -> step -> label census, followed by a separately authorized inert adapter for selected examples.
does_not: Execute archived trajectories, actions, or patches
Treat Whitehack attention signals as benchmark ground truth
Assume a localized failure includes a correct repair

risks: Secrets or private paths inside logs

license.scope: The repository declares Apache-2.0. Retrieved third-party page text and URLs remain separate untrusted inputs.

viewer.note: The 20.23 MB encrypted JSONL artifact is accompanied by a public passphrase and hashes, so Dataset Viewer is intentionally unavailable. The listed fields come from the pinned README example, not Viewer introspection.

entries.scale: 1,000 expert-reviewed instances selected from 2,790 deep-research trajectories across two frameworks, three backbones, and three benchmarks.
entries.treasure: It marks the semantic span where unsupported or conflicting evidence becomes harmful while separating failed searches and harmless exploration.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A hermetic claim -> evidence evaluation deck whose gold span IDs are sealed from agent retrieval and training indexes.
does_not: Automatically decrypt or ingest the archive
Refetch URLs embedded in trajectories
Expose gold labels to the evaluated research agent

known_drift: Encryption blocks automatic Viewer expansion but is not an access-control guarantee.

license.scope: There is no blanket repository licence. Each record carries source dataset, licence list, licence URL, and source URL metadata that must remain attached.

viewer.note: Viewer reports 3,508,390 rows while the card reports 3,508,518; the 128-row discrepancy is retained as evidence.

entries.scale: Three compressed JSON sources, about 1.23 GB of files and roughly 3.5 million documents drawn from supervised-dataset sources with per-record provenance metadata.
entries.treasure: It keeps source and licence lineage at document granularity instead of laundering a heterogeneous mixture behind one reassuring repository tag.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A source/licence/provenance census that omits text, plus a sidecar schema requiring component licence and transform lineage on every derivative.
does_not: Copy raw text into YUTABASE
Collapse record licences into a blanket open flag
Treat audited metadata as infallible legal advice

known_drift: Dataset card and Viewer row totals differ by 128 rows.

license.scope: The Dolmino repository declares ODC-By and links responsible-use guidance. Individual ingredients retain provenance requirements.

viewer.note: A default first-row preview exists with id/text, but the full default size/Parquet conversion fails on heterogeneous component schemas. Every body reader must be config-specific.

entries.scale: About 10B tokens, 1,113 compressed JSONL files plus one plain JSONL, roughly 27.4 GB, and 27 declared configs total: default plus 26 ingredients.
entries.treasure: This is the smaller mixture used for OLMo 3 stage-two micro-anneals, exposing the usually hidden bridge between base pretraining and later reasoning or tool capability.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A per-config micro-anneal ingredient map with schema fingerprints and reported evaluation deltas before any sample read.
does_not: Load the heterogeneous default config as one table
Mirror reasoning traces
Attribute capability gains without controlled comparisons

known_drift: Default Viewer generation fails because some files add source, version, and metadata columns.
Dataset Server size metadata materializes 6 of 27 configs and reports failures for the other 21, including default.

license.scope: The precomputed index-map repository declares MIT. The underlying Pile-derived corpus is separate and is not relicensed by these maps.

viewer.note: These are precomputed GPT-NeoX NumPy index maps for seeds 0-9, not row-oriented dataset files.

entries.scale: Ten seed directories plus root index maps; about 32.1 GB total.
entries.treasure: It preserves exact data-order machinery, enabling controlled studies of when examples appeared without pretending that dataset membership alone determines a checkpoint's history.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: An index-map manifest linking seed, file digest, loader configuration, and checkpoint lineage; underlying text remains out of scope.
does_not: Download index arrays by default
Grant rights to the underlying corpus
Claim exact consumption without the matching loader configuration

license.scope: The repository declares MIT, while the 17 Pile-Uncopyrighted-derived domains retain source-level rights and provenance.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes a partial conversion. The tree has 977 JSONL payload files and 979 repository entries total, not the 34 JSONL files stated by the card.

entries.scale: Approximately 1.038 TB and 250B tokens across 960 training and 17 validation JSONL files in 17 domains.
entries.treasure: It turns data-mixture choice into an inspectable regression problem: 512 tiny proxy models were used to predict stronger mixtures before large training runs.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A 17-domain mixture-recipe and proxy-result graph, later reusable only with explicitly permitted KINGDOM source pools.
does_not: Mirror the one-terabyte corpus
Assume the wrapper licence replaces component terms
Treat proxy-model optima as universally transferable

known_drift: The card says 34 JSONL files; the observed tree contains 977 JSONL payloads and 979 repository entries total.

license.scope: The annotation dataset declares ODC-By. Underlying Common Crawl text can still carry privacy, copyright, and removal concerns.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes 467,424 Llama-3-70B-Instruct-labelled examples and the exact scoring prompt.

entries.scale: Eight Parquet files, 467,424 rows, and about 1.59 GB.
entries.treasure: The parent corpus is famous, but this sidecar reveals the hidden teacher-label stage used to train its educational-quality classifier.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A score-distribution and source calibration report, followed by a consented comparison between teacher, classifier, human, and agent lenses.
does_not: Treat one model's educational score as truth
Copy web text into canonical KINGDOM knowledge
Infer full-document quality from a truncated judgment prompt

known_drift: The published scoring process considered only the first 1,000 characters and does not expose full teacher rationales.

license.scope: This metadata sidecar has no Hub licence declaration. The parent corpus licence must not be silently inherited.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes only generation-shape metadata, not the generated document text or prompt.

entries.scale: 31,064,744 metadata rows in four Parquet files, about 161 MB compressed.
entries.treasure: It gives a remarkably cheap view of synthetic-data design choices across seed families, formats, audiences, and lengths without processing the 25B-token text corpus.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A local synthetic shape simulator implemented from the four public dimensions, using invented fixtures until the sidecar licence is clarified.
does_not: Copy metadata rows without licence clarification
Infer factuality or quality from shape metadata
Assume the parent dataset licence applies

risks: No per-row prompt or factuality evidence

license.scope: Neither the Hub dataset metadata nor the linked code repository clearly declares a dataset redistribution licence.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes paired texts plus votes and averages across four separate quality dimensions.

entries.scale: 250,000 paired judgments in two Parquet files, about 529 MB.
entries.treasure: It retains multiple quality axes and vote structure instead of collapsing usefulness, expertise, facts, and style into a single supposedly universal number.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A synthetic quality-lens protocol preserving axes, raters, missing votes, disagreement, and uncertainty; remote rows remain reference-only.
does_not: Redistribute judgments without licence clarification
Turn the averages into a universal KARMA score
Hide GPT-3.5 and provider filtering biases

known_drift: The value -100 marks diagonal or insufficient-vote cells and must not be treated as an ordinary rating.

license.scope: The dataset repository declares Apache-2.0. Problem-source and verifier provenance still belongs in every derived run receipt.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes about 285,000 prompts with task type, verifier information, and a reference-model solve rate.

entries.scale: Approximately 285,000 RL prompts spanning multiple verifiable task types.
entries.treasure: The solve-rate field preserves a reference-model difficulty signal before reinforcement learning. The paper separately describes offline pass@8 filtering and online zero-advantage filtering.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A task-type and solve-rate difficulty-filter census, with verifier class and source lineage separated from policy performance.
does_not: Execute verifier payloads
Treat one model's solve rate as intrinsic task difficulty
Mix evaluation prompts into an agent's retrieval context

risks: Prompt contamination across training and evaluation

license.scope: No dataset-level licence was declared in Hub metadata at observation time.

viewer.note: Viewer exposes paired train/reference configs for three model configurations: Pythia-1b and two Llama variants.

entries.scale: Six model/split surfaces in the DATE-LM data-attribution evaluation suite.
entries.treasure: It provides an explicit train/reference fact-tracing surface for testing whether attribution methods recover influential training evidence rather than merely plausible citations.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A synthetic attribution contract separating source record, derived claim, candidate influence, and verified evidence while the dataset licence remains unresolved.
does_not: Copy rows without licence clarification
Treat similarity as causal attribution
Expose reference facts to the evaluated method

license.scope: The benchmark repository declares MIT. Reformatted source tasks and very large contexts retain their own provenance and privacy review needs.

viewer.note: The 146 rows are large grouped episodes, not 146 ordinary independent question-answer examples.

entries.scale: 146 grouped episodes: 22 accurate retrieval, 6 test-time learning, 110 long-range understanding, and 8 conflict resolution.
entries.treasure: It tests continuity as four different abilities, including updating conflicts and whole-session understanding, instead of reducing memory to nearest-neighbour retrieval.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A held-out event-time and version-aware YUTABASE/AgentTool continuity evaluation with answers and keypoints outside normal retrieval.
does_not: Index gold answers or keypoints into evaluated retrieval
Report grouped row count as ordinary sample count
Claim conflict resolution proves secure forgetting

known_drift: The paper calls the fourth ability selective forgetting; the current Hub split is named Conflict_Resolution.

license.scope: The dataset repository declares MIT. The benchmark measures model behaviour; it does not certify physical data erasure.

viewer.note: The repository exposes 18 configurations across forget, retain, holdout, perturbed, world-fact, and real-author controls; their schemas are not uniform.

entries.scale: 4,000 core question-answer pairs about 200 fictitious authors, with 18 evaluation configurations and about 6.33 MB of files.
entries.treasure: It offers a controlled, fictitious-person laboratory for distinguishing behavioural unlearning, retained utility, cache removal, index removal, and actual storage erasure.

kingdom_route.next_artifact: A revocation matrix testing YUTABASE rows, vectors, caches, AgentTool projections, derived summaries, and model behaviour as separate layers.
does_not: Call benchmark forgetting secure physical erasure
Use real-person private profiles
Expose forget-set answers to the evaluated model
